description: This file is a JavaScript ES module used as a test script for building, loading, and validating a plugin within the OpenClaw project. It sets up warnings, creates a temporary plugin directory, writes plugin configuration files, imports the plugin runtime, loads the plugin, runs assertions to verify correct plugin behavior, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Sets up a custom warning filter for process warnings, suppressing specific deprecation warnings.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes plugin commands and deletes temporary directories used for testing.
